description: Owner proposal: the interaction IS an SDP solution carrying the knot's magnitude, angle, and offset from the lattice saddle. Takes the fix named by two prior exclusions (angle-structure offset vanishes at the symmetric point; canonical confinement LP is homogeneous) by putting the braid's own operator content into the program: the Frobenius-demand LP G x = nf with nf the normal-form vector of the braid word in H_3(q). Both anchors are 3-braids ((s1 s2^-1)^2 for 4_1, ^3 for Borromean) so both live in the same 6-dim NF space. Measures the offset from the symmetric point (the lattice saddle per SymmetricOptimum) and tests the magnitude reading against the A_omega-free curve. Metric fixed in advance (Euclidean in NF coords). Nothing fitted; nothing wired.

data.program: min t.x s.t. 1^T x = n_target, G x = nf (Frobenius vector demand)

angle_to_sym.why: offset is orthogonal to the all-ones direction by construction (1^T offset = 0), so this angle is pi/2 identically and carries no information about any knot

readings_declared_together: angle_to_t (the angle of incidence onto the objective)
data.pairwise_separation_not_a_candidate: the angle BETWEEN the two anchors' offsets is one number for the pair, not one per knot, so it cannot serve as theta_K; reported only as the homogeneity-broken diagnostic
data.metric_fixed_in_advance: Euclidean in NF coordinates, identical for both anchors, chosen before any value was computed
untried_not_excluded: a G-induced (Frobenius) metric rather than Euclidean
the offset components rather than its norm
an angle to a canonical reference rather than the pairwise separation
data.verdict: THE BRAID'S OPERATOR CONTENT DOES BREAK THE HOMOGENEITY — the two anchors' offsets are genuinely non-parallel (separation 0.355119 rad), so unlike every earlier reading the direction carries knot information and the route supplies a MAGNITUDE and an ANGLE per knot rather than one scaled number. That is the falsifiability bar cleared. BUT NONE OF THE THREE DECLARED READINGS SUPPLIES ϑ: all fail the A-free curve's necessary straddling condition. WHAT IS ESTABLISHED EITHER WAY: the machinery now exists to put the braid's own operator content into the SDP — nf_of_word/hm reduces the braid word through the Grobner-Shirshov tables, G x = nf pins x* = G^-1 nf uniquely, and the offset from the symmetric point (the lattice saddle, per SymmetricOptimum) is computable per knot. Gates: sigma inverse verified against the Hecke relation, and G x* = nf to 2.93e-71. One of the three, 'angle_to_sym', turned out VACUOUS BY CONSTRUCTION — the offset is orthogonal to the all-ones direction by definition (1^T offset = 0), so that angle is pi/2 identically for every knot; it is recorded as an artifact rather than a measurement. So two substantive readings were tested, not three. SCOPE (a): the readings tested use a metric fixed in advance (Euclidean in NF coordinates). Untried and NOT excluded: a G-induced (Frobenius) metric, which is the geometrically natural one here since G is the Frobenius form the program is written in; and the offset's individual COMPONENTS (per-Wedderburn-channel) rather than any scalar summary of it. Nothing fitted; nothing wired; the S values formed the test only.
